title: 86 animations and 200 different NPC skins in my voxel colony sim
author: Arrock12
selftext:
A quick look at the NPC system I’ve been building for StoneEra.

The game currently has **86 different NPC animations** and **200 different skins**, covering movement, work, interactions, combat, and other gameplay actions.

The goal is to make a growing colony feel varied and alive instead of having everyone look and move the same.

This video shows the current animation set in action.

Would love to hear what you think — especially if there are any animations or interactions you’d like to see added.

comments.author: TheFerret404
comments.body: Looks cool, you made this with opus 5.5?

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: I animated the main part using GPT-6 Astra, and some sections using Opus.

replies.author: TheFerret404
replies.body: I am planning a game right now using opus. Have any good tips on how to set it up for cool 3D models/animations? Think this is three.js?

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: I actually made these in Blender. I used AI to help with the workflow, and the connection between the AI and Blender was through MCP.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: You can use Blender, FreeCAD, and in many cases Meshy AI as well.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: Yeah, there are 10 different base models, each with 20 color variations — so 200 combinations in total.

comments.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
comments.body:
They're all left handed and directionally challenged? (Left and right are wrong) Lol
Looks good though

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: Hahahaha, well, I’m left-handed myself, so I guess I accidentally made everyone left-handed too  hahah

comments.author: Every-Prize4720
comments.body: animations are more than just movement.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: I get your point, but considering that similar colony/management games often give NPCs maybe 5–10 core animations, I think 86 is a pretty solid starting point.      There’s definitely still a lot of polishing to do though.

replies.author: Every-Prize4720
replies.body: 5 good animations is better than infinite bad ones.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body:
I don’t really see it that way. When every specific action has its own animation, it makes the NPCs and the whole colony feel much more alive.  
And considering that most of the gameplay is viewed from a distance in third person, I think the animations are more than good enough for what they’re meant to do. There’s still room for polish, of course.
